main_text.head: HOMILIA CXV.
main_text.p: 48 Gentes autem hæc audientes, gaudebant quia sunt, & glorificabant sermonem Domini, & crediderunt quotquot erant ordinati ad vitam æternam.
49 Perferebatur autem sermo Domini per totam illam regionem.
50 Iudæi vero exitimulārunt mulieres religiosas & honestas, & primos urbis, & excitarunt persecutionem in Paulum ac Barnabam, & ejecerunt eos e finibus suis.
51 At illi excusso pulvere pedum suorum in eos, venerunt Iconium.
52 Discipuli vero replebantur gaudio & spiritu sancto.

QAmuis Domino nostro Iesu Christo a Deo patre regnum & omnis potestas data sit, eundem tamen suos in mundo aduersarios habituru, passim praedicitur, Psal. 2. 110. Zach. 12. Et de his Christus ipse Apostolos admonet, Matth. 10. Mar. 13. &c. Exemplum vero huius luculentissimum praefens historia continet. Ve

page.notes: Gothic/black letter not present. Some words in the 48–52 verses are set in italic; the heavy blotting on the left margin and the faint show-through were ignored. Doubtful readings: "exitimulārunt" (exstimularunt) and "ejecerunt" (ejecerunt/eiecerunt) are uncertain; "Iconium" and "Psal. 2. 110." may be partly obscured.
